PhotoVirtue

Prototype

Solo developer

Telegram bot plus browser and desktop photo editors, with a one-time Bitcoin payment for a year of access.

A Python project with three entry points: a Telegram bot for paid access, a FastAPI and Pillow browser editor, and a Tkinter desktop editor. Early codebase; payment and deploy wiring are still in progress.

  • FastAPI
  • Pillow
